summary: Backend smoke test for CS2 Marketplace API. 24/25 checks passed. Only failure is Stripe checkout using the placeholder key 'sk_test_emergent' — Stripe API rejects it as invalid. Per test brief, this is a known configuration issue to report separately, not an app bug. Steam interactive OpenID login not automatable — verified redirect only.
passed: GET /api/marketplace/listings returns 39 seeded items with all required fields
All filters work: rarity=covert(6), weapon_type=Rifle(14), wear=Factory New(10), min/max_price, search=AK-47(7), sort=price_desc ordering verified
GET /api/marketplace/listings/{id} valid returns item; invalid returns 404
GET /api/fx/rates returns base=USD with EUR/INR/JPY/GBP; two rapid calls return same 'updated' timestamp (cache works)
GET /api/auth/steam/login returns 307 redirect to steamcommunity.com/openid/login with correct openid.mode/ns/return_to params
JWT-authenticated flow: /auth/me returns user, POST listing creates with seller_id, GET /my/listings includes it, DELETE own listing succeeds
POST /checkout on own listing returns 400 'Cannot buy your own listing'

failed.issue: POST /api/checkout/{listing_id} returns 500 'Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent'. The STRIPE_API_KEY in backend/.env is 'sk_test_emergent' which is not a valid Stripe test key.
failed.evidence: status=500 detail='Payment provider error: Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent'. Confirmed by inspecting /app/backend/.env which contains STRIPE_API_KEY="sk_test_emergent".

action_items: Replace STRIPE_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env with a real Stripe test key (sk_test_...) to enable checkout flow. Once fixed, re-test POST /api/checkout/{listing_id} and GET /api/orders/{order_id}/status (session_id/checkout_url/order_id and order stored with status='pending' logic is already implemented correctly, just blocked by the placeholder key).

notes.mocked_flows: Escrow/trade release via POST /api/orders/{order_id}/confirm-trade is MOCKED — no real Steam trade offers. Not exercised because it requires a paid order which requires working Stripe.
notes.steam_openid: Interactive Steam login flow cannot be automated; only redirect properties verified.
notes.test_credentials_md: Present at /app/memory/test_credentials.md (not used — auth via minted JWT + Mongo user insert as instructed).
